name: Member Profile
description: A member's profile in an agent workspace: a cover and avatar, lifetime stats, a year of runs that regroups by week, month or year, runs per agent by month and recent tasks, with sharing and editing.

props.name: cover
props.description: Image for the cover band across the top. Without one the band is a plain well.

props.name: avatars
props.description: Portrait images keyed by person name, used for the member's avatar in the header and the sidebar. Without one the avatar shows initials.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at least the height of the viewport and the page scrolls. Also accepts every other div attribute.
